blockingIssues.description: Hero image is hardcoded to an external Unsplash URL instead of a bundled static asset or first trip photo as required.
Explicit activityId requests bypass the generic-title-only constraint, allowing enhancement of non-generic titles.
No-POI activities are skipped without terminal persistence, allowing repeated Geocoding/Places recomputation and violating cost-control intent.
Trip detail map/gallery segmented controls use 40px minimum height, below the required 44px touch target at tablet width.
Missing quantitative evidence for VAL-CROSS-004: no marker-to-route distance proof showing all markers within 500m.
Missing VAL-CROSS-008 end-to-end evidence for Add Photos -> Picker -> download -> marker + gallery verification in one session.
Missing VAL-CROSS-005 network evidence proving hard-refresh loads from Firebase without Strava or Google Photos API calls.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md project structure to remove non-existent public/ directory reference.
Added local route-prefix guidance to .factory/library/user-testing.md to prefer /api/... and avoid accidental /api/api/... endpoint confusion.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require explicit deviation logging when workers skip prescribed validation steps (typecheck/lint/vitest and agent-browser checks), and add a verification-only pathway if some feature classes intentionally differ.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple polish reviews reported handoffs marked followedProcedure=true while transcripts showed missing required steps (splash-and-hero, enhanced-descriptions, cross-area-integration).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add enforceable guidance for dialog bans by requiring a lint rule (e.g., no-alert) or equivalent CI check to prevent alert/confirm/prompt regressions.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Mission AGENTS bans browser dialogs, but review observations found alert() usage in active pages (Trips and TripDetail).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a pre-handoff check that recorded commitId resolves via git rev-parse/git show to prevent non-resolving full SHA metadata.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cross-area-integration review found a handoff full commitId that did not resolve while short hash resolved.
